[0.6989, 0.13], [0.5589, 0.1378], [0.8039, 0.27], [0.5589, 0.2544], [0.2361, 0.2467], [0.7883, 0.3633], [0.8156, 0.2544], [0.2867, 0.1533], [0.4889, 0.4256], [0.3489, 0.48], [0.6367, 0.3711], [0.3956, 0.5578], [0.5317, 0.2389], [0.8233, 0.3244], [0.3256, 0.06], [0.2478, 0.13], [0.8661, 0.5889], [0.3917, 0.5889], [0.5278, 0.3244], [0.5433, 0.1767], [0.7611, 0.3167], [0.59, 0.4956], [0.2011, 0.2156], [0.59, 0.55], [0.625, 0.2856], [0.1933, 0.2233], [0.6522, 0.2233], [0.5589, 0.5656], [0.9594, 0.62], [0.6094, 0.5189], [0.2944, 0.5111], [0.5394, 0.2233], [0.5511, 0.1456], [0.0572, 0.1456], [0.8156, 0.3089], [0.6211, 0.4644], [0.1933, 0.3089], [0.5472, 0.4411], [0.2439, 0.3244], [0.3644, 0.5733], [0.7494, 0.2311], [0.3722, 0.1067], [0.5822, 0.6356], [0.7572, 0.3789], [0.3567, 0.4878], [0.9983, 0.1378], [0.695, 0.2389], [0.6483, 0.2778], [0.5978, 0.2078], [0.8389, 0.2622], [0.4033, 0.0833], [0.1933, 0.1767], [0.6833, 0.0756], [0.5317, 0.4567], [0.9167, 0.6978], [0.7339, 0.1844]];

  const canvas = document.getElementById('worldmap');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  let w, h, mapPoints = [];

  function layout() {
    w = canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth;
    h = canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight;

    // Map covers the right ~78% of the banner, vertically centered,
    // slightly larger than the viewport height so it feels immersive.
    const mapW = w * 0.95;
    const mapH = mapW * 0.5; // world map aspect ~2:1
    const offsetX = w - mapW + w * 0.02;
    const offsetY = (h - mapH) / 2;

    mapPoints = WORLD_DOTS.map(([nx, ny]) => ({
      x: offsetX + nx * mapW,
      y: offsetY + ny * mapH
    }));
  }
  window.addEventListener('resize', layout);
  layout();

  // Pick a handful of "hub" points to animate glowing arcs between
  function pickHubs(count) {
    const hubs = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      hubs.push(mapPoints[Math.floor(Math.random() * mapPoints.length)]);
    }
    return hubs;
  }

  let arcs = [];
  function spawnArc() {
    const a = mapPoints[Math.floor(Math.random() * mapPoints.length)];
    const b = mapPoints[Math.floor(Math.random() * mapPoints.length)];
    arcs.push({
      a, b,
      progress: 0,
      speed: 0.006 + Math.random() * 0.006,
      life: 1
    });
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) spawnArc();

  function arcPoint(a, b, t) {
    // quadratic curve bulging upward for a "flight path" feel
    const mx = (a.x + b.x) / 2;
    const my = (a.y + b.y) / 2 - Math.hypot(b.x - a.x, b.y - a.y) * 0.18;
    const x = (1 - t) * (1 - t) * a.x + 2 * (1 - t) * t * mx + t * t * b.x;
    const y = (1 - t) * (1 - t) * a.y + 2 * (1 - t) * t * my + t * t * b.y;
    return { x, y };
  }

  let pulse = 0;

  function step() {
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
    pulse += 0.02;

    // draw static map dots
    for (const p of mapPoints) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, 1.1, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.38)';
      ctx.fill();
    }

    // draw & advance arcs
    for (let i = arcs.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const arc = arcs[i];
      arc.progress += arc.speed;

      const segments = 40;
      const headT = Math.min(arc.progress, 1);
      const tailT = Math.max(0, headT - 0.22);

      ctx.beginPath();
      for (let s = 0; s <= segments; s++) {
        const t = tailT + (headT - tailT) * (s / segments);
        const pt = arcPoint(arc.a, arc.b, t);
        if (s === 0) ctx.moveTo(pt.x, pt.y); else ctx.lineTo(pt.x, pt.y);
      }
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 43, 61, 0.55)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 1.3;
      ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(255, 43, 61, 0.9)';
      ctx.shadowBlur = 6;
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

      // glowing head dot
      const headPt = arcPoint(arc.a, arc.b, headT);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(headPt.x, headPt.y, 2.2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
      ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.9)';
      ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

      // endpoints glow softly
      [arc.a, arc.b].forEach(p => {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, 2.6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 43, 61, 0.5)';
        ctx.fill();
      });

      if (arc.progress > 1.25) {
        arcs.splice(i, 1);
        spawnArc();
      }
    }

    requestAnimationFrame(step);
  }

  step();
</script>

</body>
</html>
